tasks.title: Bug: ValidateShipment ValidShipment flag was ignored
tasks.description: shipping.py only read ResponseInformation errors; the real Development WSDL's ValidateShipmentResponse also has ValidShipment.
tasks.details: Found by scripts/verify_wsdl_wrappers.py against the real Development WSDLs (Task 16 pre-flight). A not-valid reply without error entries would have proceeded to the journal claim and CreateShipment. Fix: ShippingCoordinator now requires ValidShipment to be literally True, otherwise raises before any claim. Not yet seen against the live Development service; if Development returns the flag absent or false for a good shipment, Task 17 will show it on ValidateShipment, which creates nothing.
tasks.testStrategy: False and absent flag both stop before claim/Create (new parametrized test, verified failing without the fix); full suite 91 passed.
